title: Privacy tokens face a new challenge – Balancing anonymity with oversight
summary: When transactions are shielded in some form, anti-money laundering (AML) tracing is hindered or prevented. Privacy projects work to find an acceptable middle ground.
content: Privacy tokens are facing a growing challenge in balancing user anonymity with regulatory oversight. When cryptocurrency transactions are shielded, anti-money laundering tracing becomes difficult or impossible. Developers of privacy-focused projects are now working to find an acceptable middle ground that satisfies both privacy advocates and financial regulators.
